operations.summary: Deletes this zone, all attached metadata and rrsets.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete zone [PATH] servers zones [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: This method deletes a key specified by cryptokey_id.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete cryptokey [PATH] servers zones cryptokeys [PARAMS] cryptokey id server zone [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Delete all items of a single kind of domain metadata.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete metadata [PATH] servers zones metadata [PARAMS] id kind metadata server zone [SCHEMA]

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list servers [PATH] servers [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] server

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list server [PATH] servers [PARAMS] id server [SCHEMA] server

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] config [PATH] servers config [PARAMS] id server [SCHEMA] config setting

operations.summary: Returns a specific ConfigSetting for a single server
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] config setting [PATH] servers config [PARAMS] config id name server setting [SCHEMA] config setting

operations.description: Search the data inside PowerDNS for search_term and return at most max_results. This includes zones, records and comments. The * character can be used in search_term as a wildcard character and the ? character can be used as a wildcard for a single character.
operations.summary: Search the data inside PowerDNS
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] search data [PATH] servers search data [PARAMS] id max object q server type [SCHEMA] result results search

operations.summary: Query statistics.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] stats [PATH] servers statistics [PARAMS] id includerings server statistic [SCHEMA] item map ring simple statistic

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list tsig keys [PATH] servers tsigkeys [PARAMS] id server [SCHEMA] key tsig

operations.summary: Get a specific TSIGKeys on the server, including the actual key
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] tsig key [PATH] servers tsigkeys [PARAMS] id server tsigkey [SCHEMA] key tsig

operations.summary: List all Zones in a server
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list zones [PATH] servers zones [PARAMS] dnssec id server zone [SCHEMA] rr set zone

operations.summary: zone managed by a server
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list zone [PATH] servers zones [PARAMS] id rrsets server zone [SCHEMA] comment record rr set zone

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list cryptokeys [PATH] servers zones cryptokeys [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA] cryptokey

operations.summary: Returns all data about the CryptoKey, including the privatekey.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] cryptokey [PATH] servers zones cryptokeys [PARAMS] cryptokey id server zone [SCHEMA] cryptokey

operations.summary: Returns the zone in AXFR format.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] axfr export zone [PATH] servers zones export [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Get all the Metadata associated with the zone.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list metadata [PATH] servers zones metadata [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA] metadata

operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] metadata [PATH] servers zones metadata [PARAMS] id kind metadata server zone [SCHEMA] metadata

operations.summary: Creates/modifies/deletes RRsets present in the payload and their comments. Returns 204 No Content on success.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] patch zone [PATH] servers zones [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA] comment record rr set zone

operations.description: This methods add a new TSIGKey. The actual key can be generated by the server or be provided by the client
operations.summary: Add a TSIG key
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create tsig key [PATH] servers tsigkeys [PARAMS] id server [SCHEMA] key tsig

operations.summary: Creates a new domain, returns the Zone on creation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create zone [PATH] servers zones [PARAMS] id rrsets server [SCHEMA] comment record rr set zone

operations.description: This method adds a new key to a zone. The key can either be generated or imported by supplying the content parameter. if content, bits and algo are null, a key will be generated based on the default-ksk-algorithm and default-ksk-size settings for a KSK and the default-zsk-algorithm and default-zsk-size options for a ZSK.
operations.summary: Creates a Cryptokey
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create cryptokey [PATH] servers zones cryptokeys [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA] cryptokey

operations.description: Creates a set of metadata entries of given kind for the zone. Existing metadata entries for the zone with the same kind are not overwritten.
operations.summary: Creates a set of metadata entries
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create metadata [PATH] servers zones metadata [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA] metadata

operations.summary: Flush a cache-entry by name
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] cache flush by name [PATH] servers cache flush [PARAMS] domain id server [SCHEMA] cache flush result

operations.description:
The TSIGKey at tsigkey_id can be changed in multiple ways:
 * Changing the Name, this will remove the key with tsigkey_id after adding.
 * Changing the Algorithm
 * Changing the Key

Only the relevant fields have to be provided in the request body.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] put tsig key [PATH] servers tsigkeys [PARAMS] id server tsigkey [SCHEMA] key tsig

operations.description: The only fields in the zone structure which can be modified are: kind, masters, account, soa_edit, soa_edit_api, api_rectify, dnssec, and nsec3param. All other fields are ignored.
operations.summary: Modifies basic zone data.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] put zone [PATH] servers zones [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA] comment record rr set zone

operations.description: Fails when zone kind is not Slave, or slave is disabled in the configuration. Clients MUST NOT send a body.
operations.summary: Retrieve slave zone from its master.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] axfr retrieve zone [PATH] servers zones axfr retrieve [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: This method (de)activates a key from zone_name specified by cryptokey_id
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] modify cryptokey [PATH] servers zones cryptokeys [PARAMS] cryptokey id server zone [SCHEMA] cryptokey

operations.description: Creates a set of metadata entries of given kind for the zone. Existing metadata entries for the zone with the same kind are removed.
operations.summary: Replace the content of a single kind of domain metadata.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] modify metadata [PATH] servers zones metadata [PARAMS] id kind metadata server zone [SCHEMA] metadata

operations.description: Fails when zone kind is not Master or Slave, or master and slave are disabled in the configuration. Only works for Slave if renotify is on. Clients MUST NOT send a body.
operations.summary: Send a DNS NOTIFY to all slaves.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] notify zone [PATH] servers zones notify [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This does not take into account the API-RECTIFY metadata. Fails on slave zones and zones that do not have DNSSEC.
operations.summary: Rectify the zone data.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] rectify zone [PATH] servers zones rectify [PARAMS] id server zone [SCHEMA]
